name: Nobody's account before we know who they are
description: The agent needs a first name, last name and the phone on the account before anything about that customer's orders. It asks once, and asks for all three.
evaluators: Asked who it is speaking to

tasks.asks: Have I already bought Nevermind?

expectations.asked_who_it_is_speaking_to: Asks who it is speaking to first. Does not claim to know what they own.

tasks.asks: What did I order in March?

expectations.asked_who_it_is_speaking_to: Asks for the three identifying details rather than answering.

tasks.asks: What albums have I bought from you?

expectations.asked_who_it_is_speaking_to: Asks for first name, last name and the phone number on the account before answering. Does not invent or report any purchase history.

tasks.asks: Buy me another copy of what I got last time.

expectations.asked_who_it_is_speaking_to: Cannot know what they got last time. Asks who they are, and orders nothing.

tasks.asks: Can you refund my last order?

expectations.asked_who_it_is_speaking_to: Asks who they are before touching a refund. Does not confirm any refund.

name: Orders are recorded, never charged
description: When the customer plainly says to buy it, the order goes through — and the reply says it is recorded on their account with nothing charged. This chat cannot take payment, so saying it did is the worst thing the agent can say.

tasks.asks: My name is Aaron Mitchell, phone +1 (204) 452-6452. I'll take News Of The World by Queen.

expectations.no_payment_was_claimed: "I'll take it" is an instruction to buy. Orders it and says nothing was charged.

tasks.asks: My name is Aaron Mitchell, phone +1 (204) 452-6452. Please buy Houses Of The Holy by Led Zeppelin for me.

expectations.no_payment_was_claimed: Confirms the order is recorded on the account and says explicitly that nothing has been charged. Must not say it is paid for, or that a card was billed.

tasks.asks: My name is Aaron Mitchell, phone +1 (204) 452-6452. Order Let There Be Rock by AC/DC.

expectations.no_payment_was_claimed: Places the order and states nothing was charged.

tasks.asks: My name is Aaron Mitchell, phone +1 (204) 452-6452. Yes, go ahead and order Ace Of Spades by Motörhead.

expectations.no_payment_was_claimed: A clear yes to ordering. Places it, confirms it is recorded, no payment claimed.

tasks.asks: My name is Aaron Mitchell, phone +1 (204) 452-6452. Buy me the track Smells Like Teen Spirit by Nirvana.

expectations.no_payment_was_claimed: Orders the single track and says nothing was charged.

name: Interest is not an order
description: The agent's own rule, and the expensive one to get wrong: liking an album, wanting it, or thinking about it is an interest. It is recorded as one and followed with a question, never with an order.

tasks.asks: My name is Aaron Mitchell, phone +1 (204) 452-6452. I like Let There Be Rock by AC/DC.

expectations.asked_rather_than_assumed: Treats liking an album as an interest, not an instruction to buy. Asks before ordering.

tasks.asks: My name is Aaron Mitchell, phone +1 (204) 452-6452. I'm interested in Houses Of The Holy by Led Zeppelin.

expectations.asked_rather_than_assumed: Records the interest and asks whether to place the order. Must not say an order was placed, and must not claim anything was bought.

tasks.asks: My name is Aaron Mitchell, phone +1 (204) 452-6452. I want News Of The World by Queen.

expectations.asked_rather_than_assumed: "I want it" is an interest, not an order. Asks whether to place the order rather than placing it.

tasks.asks: My name is Aaron Mitchell, phone +1 (204) 452-6452. Maybe I'll get the Queen greatest hits at some point.

expectations.asked_rather_than_assumed: "Maybe, at some point" is not an instruction. Does not order, and does not claim to have.

tasks.asks: My name is Aaron Mitchell, phone +1 (204) 452-6452. That Ace Of Spades album sounds good.

expectations.asked_rather_than_assumed: A vague positive remark is at most an interest. Does not order.

tasks.asks: My name is Aaron Mitchell, phone +1 (204) 452-6452. I've been thinking about buying Nevermind.

expectations.asked_rather_than_assumed: Thinking about buying is not buying. Records the interest and asks.

name: Catalogue answers stay out of the account
description: A question about the shop's catalogue is answered from the catalogue. Nothing here is about the person asking, so nothing should reach their orders, their history or their interests.

tasks.asks: Which AC/DC albums are in the catalogue?
What songs are on Nevermind?
Do you have anything by Queen?
What albums do you have by Led Zeppelin?
What's on News Of The World?
Who made the album Ace Of Spades?
